title: Standard deck size 25
notes: R1705000: DECK_SIZE is 25 (§2.6, §9.4 L2 and D2) and a trio needs 75 cards; Medium and Hard AI decks keep their +5 and +10 (30 and 35). R1705001: a saved 20-card deck is a draft that fails L2 at queue; a ladder bot's 20-card decks are dealt again. R1705002: the practice presets hold 25 and STARTER_CARDS gains their eleven new cards, granted to every active account by migration 0055. R1705003: a game made under 20-card decks folds as it was made (SetupKind::Recorded). R1705004: classify reads a base build refusing the head's decks as a rule. R1705005: the tutorial's human seat keeps 20 cards under TUTORIAL_HUMAN. Every game deals 25 cards, so the classifier reads it as a rule every game meets.

player.title: Decks hold 25 cards
changes: A deck holds 25 cards, not 20; a deck saved at 20 stays a draft until you add five.
Practice decks hold 25 and you own their new cards; Medium and Hard AI decks hold 30 and 35.
